arabic_text: وَالْحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي مَنَّ عَلَيْنَا بِمُحَمَّد نَبِيِّهِ صَلَّى الله عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ دُونَ الاُمَمِ الْمَاضِيَةِ وَالْقُـرُونِ السَّالِفَةِ بِقُدْرَتِهِ الَّتِي لاَ تَعْجِزُ عَنْ شَيْء وَ إنْ عَظُمَ
transliteration: wa al-ḥamdulillāhi alladhī manna ʿalaynā bi-muḥammad nabīhī ṣallá allāh ʿalayhi wa-ālihī dūna al-umam al-māḍiyah wal-qurūn al-sāliyah bi qudratihi allati la taʿjuzu ʿan shay'in wa in ʿadhum
english_text: Praise belongs to God who was kind to us through Muhammad, His Prophet (God bless him and his Household) to the exclusion of past communities and bygone generations, displaying thereby His power, which nothing can render incapable though it be great,

arabic_text: وَ لا يَفُوتُهَا شَيءٌ وَإنْ لَطُفَ،
transliteration: wa lā yafūtuha shay'un wa-in lathufa
english_text: and nothing can escape though it be subtle.

arabic_text: فَخَتَمَ بِنَاعَلَى جَمِيع مَنْ ذَرَأَ وَ جَعَلَنَا شُهَدَاءَ عَلَى مَنْ جَحَدَ وَكَثَّرَنا بِمَنِّهِ عَلَى مَنْ قَلَّ
transliteration: fa khatama binaʿalayhi jamiʿa man tharaka wa jaʿalna shuhadā'a ʿalā man jaḥada wa kaththarana bimannihi 'ala man qalla
english_text: He sealed through us all He created, appointed us witnesses over those who deny, and increased us by His kindness over those who are few.

arabic_text: اللّهمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد أَمِينِكَ عَلَى وَحْيِكَ وَنَجِيبِكَ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَ صَفِيِّكَ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ إمَامِ الرَّحْمَةِ وَقَائِدِ الْخَيْرِ
transliteration: allāhumma faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad ʾaminika ʿalā waḥyika wa najībika min khalkika wa ṣafīyka min ʿibādika 'imāmir-raḥmati waqā'idil-khayr
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad, entrusted by Thee with Thy revelation, distinguished by Thee among Thy creatures, devoted to Thee among Thy servants, the imam of mercy, the leader of good,

arabic_text: وَ مِفْتَاحِ الْبَرَكَةِ كَمَا نَصَبَ لاَِمْرِكَ نَفْسَهُ وَ عَرَّضَ فِيْكَ لِلْمَكْرُوهِ بَدَنَهُ وَكَاشَفَ فِي الدُّعَآءِ إلَيْكَ حَامَّتَهُ
transliteration: wa miftāhi al-barakah kamā naṣaba li-amrika nafsahu wa ʿarraf fīka lil-makroohi badanahu wa kashafa fi al-du'a'i ilayka hāmmatahu
english_text: the key to blessing, who wearied his soul for Thy affairs, exposed his body to detested things for Thy sake, showed open enmity toward his next of kin by summoning to Thee,

arabic_text: وَحَارَبَ فِي رِضَاكَ أسْرَتَهُ وَقَطَعَ فِىْ إحْياءِ دِينِكَ رَحِمَهُ وَاقصَى الادْنَيْنَ عَلَى جُحُـودِهِمْ وَقَرَّبَ الاقْصَيْنَ عَلَى اسْتِجَابَتِهِمْ لَكَ
transliteration: waḥārab fī riḍāka asratahu waqaṭaʿa fii iḥyaaʾi dīnika raḥimahu wa aqṣā al-adnayni ʿalā juḥūdihim wa qar-raba al-aqṣayn ʿalā istijābatihim laka
english_text: fought against his family for Thy good pleasure, cut the ties of the womb in giving life to Thy religion, sent far those close because of their denial, brought near those far because of their response to Thee,

arabic_text: وَ والَى فِيكَ الابْعَدِينَ وَعَادى فِيكَ الاقْرَبِينَ وَأدْأبَ نَفْسَهُ فِي تَبْلِيغِ رِسَالَتِكَ وَأَتْعَبَهَا بِالدُّعآءِ إلَى مِلَّتِكَ
transliteration: wa wallā fīka al-abʿadīn wa ʿādā fīka al-aqrabīn wa-ada'ba nafsahu fi tablighi risalatika wa atʿabahā bid-duʿāʾi ilā millatika
english_text: showed friendship to the most distant for Thy sake, displayed enmity toward the nearest for Thy sake, made his soul persevere in delivering Thy message, tired it in summoning to Thy creed,

arabic_text: وَشَغَلَهَا بِالنُّصْحِ لاَِهْلِ دَعْوَتِكَ وَهَاجَرَ إلَى بِلاَدِ الْغُرْبَةِ وَمحَلِّ النَّأيِ عَنْ مَوْطِنِ رَحْلِهِ وَمَوْضِـعِ رِجْلِهِ وَمَسْقَطِ رَأسِهِ
transliteration: wa shaghala-ha bi-nnuṣḥi li-ahl-i daʿwatik wa hajara ila biladi al-ghurba wa mahallu al-naʾyi ʿan mawṭini rahlihi wa mawḍiʿi rijlihi wa masqaṭi raʾsihi
english_text: busied it in counselling those worthy of Thy summons, migrated to the land of exile and the place of remoteness from the home of his saddlebags, the walkway of his feet, the ground of his birth,

arabic_text: وَمَأنَسِ نَفْسِهِ إرَادَةً مِنْهُ لاعْزَازِ دِيْنِكَ واسْتِنْصَاراً عَلَى أَهْلِ الْكُفْرِ بِكَ حَتّى اسْتَتَبَّ لَهُ مَا حَاوَلَ فِي أَعْدَائِكَ وَاسْتَتَمَّ لَهُ مَا دَبَّرَ فِي أوْلِيآئِكَ
transliteration: wa ma 'anasi nafsihi iradatan minhu l'azazi deenik wa-stinṣārāan ʿalā ahli-l-kufri bika ḥattā istatabba lahū mā ḥāwala fī aʿdāʾika wa stamtam lahu ma dabbara fi awliya'ik
english_text: and the intimate abode of his soul, desiring to exalt Thy religion and seeking help against those who disbelieved in Thee, until what he attempted against Thy enemies went well with him and what he arranged for Thy friends was accomplished.

arabic_text: فَنَهَدَ إلَيْهِمْ مُسْتَفْتِحاً بِعَوْنِكَ وَمُتَقَوِّياً عَلَى ضَعْفِهِ بِنَصْرِكَ
transliteration: fanahada ilayhim mustaf'tiḥan bi'awnika wa mutaqawwiyān ʿalā ḍaʿfih bi-naṣrik
english_text: He rose up against them seeking victory through Thine aid, becoming strong in spite of his weakness with Thy help.

arabic_text: فَغَزَاهُمْ فِي عُقْرِ دِيَارِهِمْ وَهَجَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ فِي بُحْبُوحَةِ قَرَارِهِمْ حَتّى ظَهَر أَمْرُكَ وَعَلَتْ كَلِمَتُكَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ
transliteration: faghazāhum fī ʿuqri diyārihim wa hajama ʿalayhim fi buhbuuhati qararihim ḥattá ẓahara amruk waʿalat kalimatuka walaw karihal mushrikoon
english_text: He fought against them in the centre of their cities and attacked them in the midst of their dwellings, until Thy command prevailed, and Thy word rose up, though the idolaters were averse.

arabic_text: اللَهُمَّ فَارْفَعْهُ بِمَا كَدَحَ فِيكَ إلَى الدَّرَجَةِ الْعُلْيَا مِنْ جَنَّتِكَ حَتَّى لاَ يُسَاوَى فِي مَنْزِلَة وَلا يُكَاْفَأَ فِي مَرْتَبَة
transliteration: allāhumma fārfʿahū bimā kadaha fīka 'ilā al-darajati al-ʿulyā min jannatika ḥattā lā yusāwā fī manzilah wa lā yukāfā’u fī martabah
english_text: O God, so raise him, because of his labours for Thy sake, to the highest degree of Thy Garden, that none may equal him in station, none may match him in level,

arabic_text: وَلاَ يُوَازِيَهُ لَدَيْكَ مَلَكٌ مُقَرَّبٌ وَلا نبيٌّ مُرْسَلٌ
transliteration: walā yuwāziyahū ladayka malakun muqarrabun walā nabiyyun mursalun
english_text: and no angel brought nigh or prophet sent out may parallel him in Thy sight.

arabic_text: وَعَرِّفْهُ فِي أهْلِهِ الطّاهِرِينَ وَاُمَّتِهِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْ حُسْنِ الشَّفَاعَةِ أجَلَّ مَا وَعَدْتَهُ يَا نَافِذَ الْعِدَةِ
transliteration: wa ʿarrifhu fī ahlihi aṭ-ṭāhirīn wa-ummahatihi al-mu'minīn min husni al-shafāʿah 'ajalla mā wa'adtahu yā nāfidh al-'idah
english_text: And inform him concerning his Household the pure and his community the faithful of an excellent intercession, greater than what Thou hast promised him! O Keeper of promises!

arabic_text: وَافِىَ الْقَوْلِ يَا مُبَدِّلَ السّيِّئات بِأضْعَافِهَا مِنَ الْحَسَنَاتِ
transliteration: waāfiyal-qawli yā mubaddila al-sayyiāti bi-ađʿāfihā min al-ħasanāt
english_text: O Faithful to Thy word! O He who changes evil deeds into manifold good deeds!

arabic_text: إنَّكَ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ الْجَوَادُ اَلْكَرِيمُ
transliteration: ʾinnaka dhū al-faḍli al-ʿaẓīmi al-jawādu al-karīmu
